nav_map_disagrees.json: .nav.map: a ready graph for another map is the wrong graph, and drills against it would fail for a reason that has nothing to do with the bot
nav_on_a_two_sided_tier.json: .nav: only T1 and T2 measure against exactly one graph; T0 has none and a two-sided tier has two, so a single stamp here could not say which one it described
nav_ready_without_graph.json: .nav.cells: a ready graph with zero cells is not a graph
nav_state_not_ready.json: .nav.state: the runner refuses to measure on a graph that is not ready, so any other value in a written envelope is a stamp nothing produced
t1_abandoned_null_bound.json: .payload.scenarios[0].attempts[2].min_possible_s: an abandoned attempt's bound is a number, not a null wearing the key
t1_abandoned_without_bound.json: .payload.scenarios[0].attempts[2].min_possible_s: an abandoned attempt without its bound has thrown away the only thing it knew
t1_absence_not_named.json: .payload: a T1 run on a build without telemetry must declare 't1:stall' as unavailable: its stalls were recorded as timeouts
t1_best_time_invented.json: .payload.scenarios[0].best_time_s: must be the fastest arrival (5.37), not 999.0
t1_bound_on_arrival.json: .payload.scenarios[0].attempts[0].min_possible_s: an attempt that arrived carries its time, not a bound
t1_bound_on_timeout.json: .payload.scenarios[0].attempts[2].min_possible_s: a bound only exists for an attempt abandoned as impossible
t1_declared_yet_graded.json: .payload.scenarios: capabilities.unavailable names 't1:ra_climb' as missing, yet the drill was run and graded
t1_flag_contradicts_list.json: .capabilities.unavailable: names t1:stall as missing while capabilities.telemetry says the engine emits it
t1_link_without_from.json: .payload.scenarios[0].evidence.link: carries a moment but no 'from' to open at
t1_missing_nav.json: .nav: a complete T1/T2 run measured against a graph, and the envelope has to name which one
t1_offroute_with_time.json: .payload.scenarios[0].attempts[1]: time_s is present exactly for attempts that arrived
t1_quick_two_attempts.json: .payload.scenarios[10].attempts: a quick run grades no drill on fewer than three attempts
t1_withheld_undeclared.json: .payload.scenarios: rj_pent_to_lifts_to_window_to_quad was withheld for a missing capability, but capabilities.unavailable does not name 't1:rj_pent_to_lifts_to_window_to_quad'
t1_withheld_without_reason.json: .payload.scenarios[1].verdict: a drill without a verdict has to name the capability the build was missing
t1_withheld_yet_attempted.json: .payload.scenarios[1].attempts: a withheld drill was never run
t1_withheld_yet_capable.json: .payload.scenarios[1].verdict: a drill without a verdict has to name the capability the build was missing
t2_bad_lead.json: .payload.moments[0].link: must open three seconds before the moment, opens 8.20 s before
t2_declared_yet_counted.json: .capabilities.unavailable: names stall_firings as missing while capabilities.telemetry says the engine emits it
t2_excuse_for_another_field.json: .capabilities.unavailable: says the engine emits no telemetry but names nothing that depends on it (expected one of cells, stall_firings, t1:stall)
t2_kinds_do_not_sum.json: .payload: invariant failed: stall_firings != sum(kinds) — every firing happened on exactly one kind of route leg, offroute included
t2_measured_without_telemetry.json: .payload.stats.stall_firings: named in capabilities.unavailable, yet a count is reported
t2_null_with_cells.json: .payload.cells: zones from a build that emits no stall events
t2_null_without_reason.json: .payload.stats.stall_firings: a measurement that did not happen must be named in capabilities.unavailable
t4_continues_after_loss.json: .payload.ladder[1]: ladder continues after a loss or draw
